toolId.description: If not specified, the ID will be generated to include the method name and a random suffix.

skipValidation.description:
The base version of {@link GenaiCore.Tool.C3Method} currently only supports methods whose parameters
and return value are all primitives ({@link PrimitiveType}). If `skipValidation` is not set `true`, then
the method will be validated to ensure that it meets this requirement.

overload.description: The overload of the method to use. If the method has only one overload, this field should be omitted.

doNotUpsert.description: If true, then the created tool will be returned but not upserted.

title: A spec for creating a {@link GenaiCore.Tool.C3Method} instance.
